disclaimer: Licenses and terms change. Every source is marked with its best-known license, but `verifyBeforeIngest` sources MUST have their current terms re-checked at ingest time. 'publicly accessible' never implies 'redistributable' — the ingestion gate (lib/ingest-guard.js) fails closed on restricted/unknown licenses. This catalog is the governed subset of public data, not 'all' of it.

licenseKeys.public-domain: US Government works / public domain — free reuse, no attribution required
licenseKeys.cc-by: Creative Commons Attribution — reuse with credit
licenseKeys.cc-by-sa: CC Attribution-ShareAlike — credit + same license on derivatives
licenseKeys.odbl: Open Database License — attribution + share-alike for databases
licenseKeys.restricted: Reuse limited by terms (commercial/redistribution/share-alike constraints) — gate blocks by default
licenseKeys.unknown: License not established — gate blocks until resolved

sources.name: Data.gov (US)
sources.notes: Federal open-data catalog; individual datasets carry their own terms.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.notes: Corporate filings; fair-access rate limit + declared User-Agent required.

sources.name: US Census Bureau API
sources.notes: Aggregated statistics; no individual records.

sources.name: Federal Register API
sources.notes: Rules, notices, executive orders.

sources.name: USPTO PatentsView
sources.notes: Inventor names are public record but are personal data — treat as low PII.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
sources.notes: Trial registrations; contact fields can carry investigator PII.

sources.name: openFDA
sources.notes: Adverse-event reports are de-identified but narrative fields need a PII scan.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.notes: CC BY 4.0 — attribution required in served output.

sources.name: IMF Data
sources.notes: Terms limit redistribution — confirm before caching for re-serve.

sources.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
sources.notes: Many series carry the originating provider's own terms — per-series check.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.notes: Metadata is CC0; full-text license is per-paper (author choice) — verify before caching bodies.

sources.name: PubMed Central Open Access Subset
sources.notes: OA subset only; individual articles carry CC-BY/BY-NC/BY-SA variants — read per-article license.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.notes: CC0 structured facts; excellent entity backbone.

sources.name: NASA Open APIs
sources.notes: Imagery/space-weather; some imagery has third-party rights — check per-endpoint.

sources.name: NOAA / National Weather Service
sources.notes: Forecasts, alerts, observations.

sources.name: GBIF (Biodiversity)
sources.notes: Dataset-level licenses vary (CC0/BY/BY-NC) — resolve per occurrence dataset.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.notes: ODbL — attribution + share-alike on derived databases. Don't hammer the main API; use extracts.

sources.name: US Census TIGER/Line
sources.notes: Boundaries, roads, geographic reference.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.notes: Public-domain base-map vectors/rasters.

sources.name: CourtListener / RECAP
sources.notes: Opinions are public domain; dockets/filings can contain personal data — PII scan mandatory.

sources.name: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard)
sources.notes: US case law, now openly published; older cases may name private individuals.

sources.name: EUR-Lex (EU law)
sources.notes: Reuse allowed with conditions (attribution + non-distortion) — confirm before re-serve.

sources.name: Common Crawl
sources.notes: Crawl of the open web: contains copyrighted pages AND personal data. Gate must block re-serve of third-party content; usable for analysis, not redistribution.

sources.name: GDELT Project
sources.notes: Global news event index; links to third-party articles you cannot redistribute wholesale.

sources.name: OpenCorporates
sources.notes: Share-alike + commercial-use restrictions; officer names are personal data.

sources.name: UK Companies House
sources.notes: Open Government Licence w/ attribution; director data is personal — GDPR applies.
